intro: Talo Thornhoof was once a seasoned hunter who feared no creature, until harpies ambushed Talo in the forest. The hate has boiled inside ever since, and Talo asks you to take revenge on the Northspring harpies, found to the west.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...
I was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.
Even now, I can still hear their cries echoing...
I was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.
The Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. Friend, get my revenge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The wings of the Northspring harpies are black as the night; do not take your eyes off of them, lest they disappear into darkness.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. You have put an old tauren's mind at peace.
